name: Snow Angel and Silver Devil
source:
[i]Wolkendorf legend whispers of a ferocious beast that prowls the shadows of every snowfall...[/i]

Once upon a time, in the woods near the sleepy town of Wolkendorf, Germany, there lived a healer named Catrin Rosenberg.  On her way to her relatives' house for Heiligabend dinner, she crosses paths with the frosted behemoth known as the Silver Devil. But is he truly as ferocious and fearsome as the tales claim?

What new and wondrous legends will be spun from this chance encounter between angel and devil? ...Well, that's up for you to decide, isn't it?

[From [url=https://madame-photon.itch.io/snow-angel-and-silver-devil]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]沃尔肯多夫传说传说有一只凶猛的野兽在每次降雪的阴影中徘徊……[/i]

很久以前，在德国宁静的沃尔肯多夫小镇附近的树林里，住着一位名叫卡特琳·罗森伯格的治疗师。在去亲戚家吃海利加本德晚餐的路上，她遇到了被称为银魔的霜冻巨兽。但他真的像传说中那样凶猛可怕吗？

这场天使与魔鬼的邂逅，又会编织出怎样新奇的传奇呢？……好吧，这由你决定，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://madame-photon.itch.io/snow-angel-and-silver-devil]itch.io[/url]]
